about: How docs/captures/exposed-host.txt was made, from the exposed-host entry of docs/chooser.json. scripts/chooser-captures.mjs writes both files; regenerate them with node scripts/chooser-captures.mjs --write.
ranIn: a copy of the fixture folder, under its own name, in a new temporary folder
served: by serve.mjs of the fixture, started there before the command and stopped after it; <port> is the free port it listened on

environment.TMPDIR: the temporary folder of the process that ran the script

output: standard output and standard error in one file, in the order the command wrote them

normalizers.does: Removes the NanoMind classifier download notice, which a run on an empty model cache prints and a later run does not.
Prints the temporary folder that holds the fixture copy as "...", so a path reads ".../insecure-library/.env".
Prints the port the fixture's server listened on, a free one chosen at run time, as <port> wherever that number stands alone.
Prints the version on the "Scanned with hackmyagent" line as <version>, so a release alone changes no capture.
Prints a "Duration:" count of milliseconds as <n>ms.
Removes spaces and tabs at the end of each line.
